# Chemist
1. Your direct superior is the Chief Medical Officer.
2. Chemists are expected to synthesize the required chemicals to ensure that the medical bay has proper medication for patients.
3. All medicines should be labeled as follows: - Chemical name. - Chemical effect/major side effects. - Overdose limits. - Any interfering chemicals (i.e. Lacinerol & Bicardine react to form Razorium)
4. Chemists are to provide medication in various different forms, such as pills, patches, or fluids to be used in injections.
5. Chemists are expected to provide medication to the Brigmedic after the initial set of chemicals produced for the Medical Department are completed. These must also be in the form of fluids, patches and pills.
6. Non-illegal chemicals may be synthesized and prescribed by chemists at their discretion.
7. Chemists are responsible for safely storing contraband chemicals away from the station at large, with a log of the information written in the Chemical Contraband Form.
